claim: With AWS PrivateLink, resources in a VPC connect to AWS services using private IP addresses, so you do not need an internet gateway or NAT device to access AWS services; gateway VPC endpoints give connectivity to Amazon S3 and DynamoDB without an internet gateway or NAT device.

evidence.quote: You can use [AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/) to enable resources in your VPC to connect to AWS services using private IP addresses, as if those services were hosted directly in your VPC. Therefore, you do not need to use an internet gateway or NAT device to access AWS services.
Gateway VPC endpoints provide reliable connectivity to Amazon S3 and DynamoDB without requiring an internet gateway or a NAT device for your VPC.
